notes.title: Thank you for nominating Ghost of Tsushima for the Steam Awards!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

We are incredibly proud to have Ghost of Tsushima Director's Cut on PC nominated for two Steam Awards!

We're honored to see so many of you enjoying Jin Sakai's story and considering us for the Outstanding Story-Rich Game Award. We're equally grateful for the nominations for the Best Game You Suck At Award. Listen, there's no shame in lowering that difficulty setting. Honor died on the beach, but you don't have to!

If these nominations resonate with you, we'd love for you to cast your vote using the buttons above. 

On behalf of the teams at Sucker Punch and Nixxes: we wish you happy holidays and thank YOU for playing Ghost of Tsushima on PC!

notes.title: Ghost of Tsushima Director's Cut Patch 7 Release Notes
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,  

Patch 7 for Ghost of Tsushima Director's Cut on PC is available now. This update resolves an issue that could prevent the Living Legends and Light the Way achievements from unlocking for some players. We've also fixed an issue that could cause unintended light bloom effects on AMD Radeon GPUs and made various improvements to cross-platform matchmaking in Legends mode.

This update includes game-integration for AMD Radeon Anti-Lag 2. This input-lag minimizing feature is available on AMD Radeon RX 5000 graphics cards and newer, with AMD Software: Adrenalin Edition 24.6.1 or newer drivers. When Anti-Lag 2 is enabled in the game, you can press Alt+Shift+L to enable the Radeon Anti-Lag 2 Latency Monitor. 

Thanks to everyone for playing Ghost of Tsushima on PC and for providing feedback to help us further improve the game!

notes.title: AMD FSR 3.1 is now available in Ghost of Tsushima Director's Cut
notes.notes:
Hey everyone 

We're excited to announce the availability of AMD FSR 3.1 in Ghost of Tsushima Director's Cut. We have been working closely with AMD to incorporate this performance-enhancing technology, which can be used with recent graphics cards from AMD, Intel and NVIDIA.  

AMD FSR 3.1 offers improved FSR upscaling quality, with less flickering and better preservation of detail, compared to previous versions. Like our existing implementation of FSR 3.0 in the game, it is possible to use AMD FSR frame generation in combination with any upscaling technology available in the game for your graphics card. 

This update also resolves an issue with the HDR Max Luminance slider so that it is not capped to 1000 nits anymore. We have also made several changes to improve Legends co-op multiplayer matchmaking. 

Thanks to everyone for playing Ghost of Tsushima Director's Cut on PC and for sharing your feedback with us! 

[h3]Release notes v1053.5.0625.1621[/h3]
[list]
[*]Updated AMD FSR to version 3.1 with improved upscaling quality. 
[*]Fixed an issue with the HDR Max Luminance slider that caused it to cap at 1000 nits. 
[*]Improvements to Legends co-op multiplayer matchmaking.
[/list]

notes.title: Ghost of Tsushima Director's Cut PC launch details
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, 

Ghost of Tsushima Director's Cut is releasing on PC soon. We're excited for you to experience Jin's journey, the Iki Island expansion, and Legends co-op multiplayer!

You can now pre-load the game on Steam. By doing so, you can download the game ahead of its release on May 16. Ghost of Tsushima Director's Cut launches on May 16 at 8:00 AM PDT / 5:00 PM CEST / 7:00 PM GST. Check out the infographic below for more time zones (click to enlarge).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44913290/6af6de68b44db0678f0bce2ff6da0f19eecb1ff4.jpg[/img]
[h3]Legends co-operative multiplayer[/h3]
As previously announced, Legends co-op multiplayer mode will include cross-play between players on PS4 consoles, PS5 consoles and PC. Legends will be functional on PC at launch, but you won't be automatically matched with players on different platforms. Cross-play will launch in beta, meaning you can try it out by inviting your PlayStation Network friends. We would love your feedback as we continue to make adjustments in the weeks following launch!
[h3]Steam Deck support[/h3]
We know many of you are eager to play Ghost of Tsushima Director's Cut on handheld gaming devices like the Steam Deck. We're happy to share that the single player experience, including the Iki Island expansion, can be enjoyed on Steam Deck and similar handheld gaming PCs as we’ve worked extensively to optimize performance and deliver the best possible experience on these devices.

You may notice that Steam marks the game as 'Unsupported' for Steam Deck. This is due to the Legends co-op multiplayer mode requiring Windows to access PlayStation Network integrated features. 

On behalf of everyone at Nixxes and Sucker Punch, we can't wait for PC players to start their adventure and fight for the freedom of Tsushima!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44913290/15e4f805652435ef83ab26cd0ad67dbb31b4ce26.jpg[/img]
